claims.claim: Frame references for all 7 episodes were generated without failure.
All 7 episodes were aligned, and episode 14 used the yaw_hum choice because the object and human yaw disagree.
Both CSV files passed validation in the dry run, and nothing was submitted.
The frame-0 check of version a passes, and after alignment episode 12 and episode 27 have small orientation differences while episode 14 still has a large one.
The frame-0 check of version b passes.
Version a differs from the submitted CSV in exactly episodes 5, 10, 12, 14, 15, 23 and 27.
Version b differs from the submitted CSV in exactly episodes 5, 10, 14, 15 and 23, and episodes 12 and 27 are unchanged.
After alignment episode 14 has a frame-0 orientation difference below 5 degrees.
